findings.title: Raw Tailwind color literal bypassing the semantic token system
findings.fix: Added primary.hover (#ea580c) to tailwind.config.js, swapped all 5 usages to hover:bg-primary-hover.

findings.title: 2 inline SVGs with no aria-label/aria-hidden
findings.evidence: Hero.tsx:41, ScoreCard.tsx:33 score-ring SVGs exposed to assistive tech with no label
findings.fix: Added aria-hidden="true" to both (the score is already announced via adjacent text).

findings.title: 3 full-height containers using 100vh with no dvh fallback
findings.evidence: App.tsx, ErrorBoundary.tsx, ResultPage.tsx all used min-h-screen alone
findings.fix: Added supports-[height:100dvh]:min-h-[100dvh] alongside min-h-screen on all three.

findings.title: Repo URL input had no accessible label
findings.evidence: UrlInput.tsx:45 -- placeholder was the only name for the field
findings.fix: Added a visually-hidden <label> tied to the input via htmlFor.

findings.title: 6 buttons missing explicit type attribute
findings.fix: Added type="button" to all 6 (3 other linter hits were false positives -- already correct).

findings.title: mixBlendMode set via inline style where a Tailwind utility exists
Arbitrary z-[9999] on the splash screen
findings.fix: Normalized to z-[1000], one step above LoadingScreen's z-[999].

findings.title: @import render-blocking chain -- false positive
findings.evidence: index.css:1-3; verified zero @import statements in the production bundle (Vite inlines Tailwind layers at build time)
findings.fix: No fix needed -- dev-only artifact, does not reach production.

findings.title: Border+shadow depth-cue duplication on 3 cards (deferred)
findings.fix: Deferred to the /ux-design glass-panel material split -- needs a design decision (which depth cue survives per surface type), not a mechanical swap.

prioritized_fix_list: Semantic hover token (primary-hover) replacing raw orange-600 literal
Accessible label on the URL input
